correctness.rationale: For every fixed sigma>0 and every upper/lower nonvertex boundary pole of the specified disk-union domain, differentiating the pole gives the exact P_n times two Laplace integrals with R_t=x²/[2((x-t)²+b²)] and gamma prefactor P_n~sqrt(pi)/(2 Gamma(sigma)^2)n^(2sigma-5/2). On 1/4<a<3/4 both t=a,1-a have endpoint R=1, slopes 16t-4, giving n^(2sigma-7/2) and the claimed pair of constants. On straight segments only the nearer t has an interior Gaussian R=1 at x=2a, giving n^(2sigma-3), and at junction its half-Gaussian gives pi*8^sigma/(16 Gamma(sigma)^2). The exact rational cap/straight expressions with a=1/4+eta/sqrt(n) yield a dominated erfc(4eta) transition uniformly on compact eta; separate far endpoint stays O(1/n). Cone comparison gives Bergman threshold sigma<1, while p-series yields cap trace threshold sigma<5/4 and straight/junction sigma<1. Independent adaptive quadratures of exact original-energy integrals at n=1800, sigma=1.1, a in {.1,.25,.4,.6,.75,.9} gave normalized asymptotic ratios .99996,.99596,.99815,.99815,.99596,.99996. These finite tests do not prove n→∞. Domain vertices 0 and 1, arbitrary holomorphic inputs, global eta uniformity explicitly excluded.
